ai-record-experimental.name: Experimental AI macro attempt (next level)
ai-record-experimental.description: OFF by default. Try bounded single-button classic-level attempts on Android. After a completion, re-enter the same level for a verification replay; a candidate .gdr.json is saved locally only if both runs match. It may fail, and xdBot import is not yet verified. Manual input or disabling this setting cancels AI. No website upload.
